history.rationale: reproducing test FAILS on buggy and PASSES on fixed; numerical probes are disabled (--no-probes), so the test transition is the whole of the evidence

plans.objective: Reproduce pandas timedelta ndarray multiplication overflow tests with real buggy failure vs fixed PASS by adjusting build/environment (E_B, E_F), not the developer test T_dev.
assumptions: The reproducing patch already makes the developer test select the named file+case and is applied in both /workspace/buggy and /workspace/fixed.

The failing/broken behavior is in compiled code paths (pandas._libs.tslibs.timedeltas) so a dependency/build mismatch can cause the buggy-side to fail incorrectly (e.g., setup/collection or different exception).

actions.step: Verify current Python interpreter versions in both sandboxes (to decide whether rebuild is needed)

Build both revisions with compiled extensions against a stable NumPy that matches the era and ensures consistent ndarray multiplication semantics (avoid any accidental ABI/behavior drift)
Run only the selected developer-test case against buggy revision; it must FAIL for the right reason (not import/setup)
Run the same selected developer-test case against fixed revision; it must PASS

plans.success_criterion: Transition occurs: selected test case fails on buggy revision with a real assertion/expected exception mismatch, and passes on fixed revision without the mismatch.
